title: The time-pinned test finder sees a clock read inside a helper function
why: Incident 13:31 CST Nov 12 (lane fan-code-agents, via coordinator): lint/find_time_pinned.py missed a clock read inside a helper; two timing tests slipped past it and broke test-strategy-reset item 2.
note: Fix: the finder follows a test's calls into helpers in the same file (and imported test helpers) and flags a clock read there. Red first on the two tests from the incident. Kin: finder-bare-date-cases, finder-deadline-poll. Start when ranked.
